title: "Parent Awareness"
---

## 👨‍👩‍👧 Parent awareness

Parents can help children develop healthy digital routines without treating technology as completely negative.

<div class="card-grid">
<div class="card blue">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/parent_guidance.svg">
<h3>Guide, don't just restrict</h3>
<p>Set clear routines and explain why limits are useful.</p>
</div>

<div class="card orange">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/phone_free_time.svg">
<h3>Create phone-free family time</h3>
<p>Meals, conversations and family activities should include real interaction.</p>
</div>

<div class="card violet">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/family_time.svg">
<h3>Replace screen convenience</h3>
<p>For young children, use talking, reading, play and interaction instead of relying on a device for every difficult moment.</p>
</div>

<div class="card green">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/outdoor_play.svg">
<h3>Encourage active childhood</h3>
<p>Support outdoor play, sports, hobbies, music, dance and other skills.</p>
</div>
</div>

## Parent takeaway

**Model the behaviour you want children to learn.** A family routine that includes sleep, physical activity, conversation, study and responsible technology use is more useful than a simple “no phone” rule.
